explanation: Raw audio files exhibited notable recording variations (mean dumb baseline accuracy: 72.4%), demonstrating that classifiers on unnormalized audio can inadvertently exploit microphone encoding, sample rate, or duration shortcuts. After telephony profile normalization (16 kHz mono, 300–3400 Hz band-pass, -20 dBFS loudness norm, silence trimming), the acoustic baseline accuracy dropped to 59.6%, forcing the model to rely on genuine temporal rhythm and prosody.
